scope:
A fail-closed SSA137 correction for ONE authenticated saved bright witness.

Not wired into pixel_bright or v3. No cast16/multiple-parameter inverse support.
domain: exact authenticated saved half3 operands only; no implicit neighborhood or other caller

cast16_and_multiple_parameter_rejections.cast16: This accepted inverse work covers fixed cast0 and field3 only; cast16/multiple free parameters are unverified and prohibited
cast16_and_multiple_parameter_rejections.multiple_parameters: This accepted inverse work covers fixed cast0 and field3 only; cast16/multiple free parameters are unverified and prohibited
